Title: Azure Site Recovery availability with Resource Manager in Azure Government

Body.Content:
Azure Site Recovery is now generally available in the Azure portal in the Azure Government cloud.

Apart from bringing all the existing scenarios to the new experience, users can take advantage of the following enhancements:

  • Azure Resource Manager support
  • Azure Backup and Azure Site Recovery: Capability to use one Recovery Services vault for backup and disaster recovery.
  • Exclude disks: Capability to exclude disks from replication to optimize target-side resources.
  • Support for additional storage types: Premium and locally redundant storage

To get started, request an Azure Government trial subscription. If you already have an Azure Government subscription, you can try out Azure Site Recovery.
